title: 把 vs 被 Step 3 · Flip It: 把 ↔ 被
description: Every 把 sentence can flip into a 被 sentence. Swap the people around and keep track of who got what.

points.title: Flipping
points.summary: A 把 B + verb … ⇄ B 被 A + verb … — the verb and result stay the same.
points.body:
- 小狗**把**我的鞋咬坏了。 ⇄ 我的鞋**被**小狗咬坏了。
- 风**把**门吹开了。 ⇄ 门**被**风吹开了。

| | pattern | the subject … | feeling |
|---|---|---|---|
| **把** | doer + 把 + thing + verb + result | **does** something to the thing | what you did to it |
| **被** | thing + 被 + (doer) + verb + result | **receives** the action | often bad luck: got …ed |

**Both** need something after the verb: ~~我把饭吃~~ → 我把饭吃**完了** · ~~杯子被打~~ → 杯子被打**破了**.
**没 / 不 / 想 / 要** go **before** 把 / 被: 我**没**把作业做完 · 他**没**被抓住.
examples: My shoe got chewed up by the puppy.

points.title: Who got what?
points.summary: The noun right after 把 receives the action; the noun right after 被 does it.
points.body:
- 我**被**他打了 → **I** got hit.
- 我**把**他打了 → **he** got hit.

| | pattern | the subject … | feeling |
|---|---|---|---|
| **把** | doer + 把 + thing + verb + result | **does** something to the thing | what you did to it |
| **被** | thing + 被 + (doer) + verb + result | **receives** the action | often bad luck: got …ed |

**Both** need something after the verb: ~~我把饭吃~~ → 我把饭吃**完了** · ~~杯子被打~~ → 杯子被打**破了**.
**没 / 不 / 想 / 要** go **before** 把 / 被: 我**没**把作业做完 · 他**没**被抓住.

questions.prompt: Flip 「{小狗|xiǎogǒu}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{鞋|xié}{咬|yǎo}{坏|huài}{了|le}。」 into a 被 sentence.
questions.explanation: 我的鞋**被小狗**咬坏了。 The receiver moves to the front.
questions.translation: My shoe got chewed up by the puppy.

questions.prompt: Flip 「{窗户|chuānghu}{被|bèi}{他|tā}{打开|dǎkāi}{了|le}。」 into a 把 sentence.
questions.explanation: **他把窗户**打开了。 The doer moves to the front.

questions.prompt: 「{我|wǒ}{被|bèi}{他|tā}{打|dǎ}{了|le}。」 vs 「{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{打|dǎ}{了|le}。」 — who got hit?
options: 1st: I got hit · 2nd: he got hit
1st: he got hit · 2nd: I got hit
notes: Swapped: after 被 comes the hitter.
In the 2nd, 我 is the doer.
In the 1st, 我 is the receiver.

questions.explanation: The person right after **把** receives it; the one right after **被** does it.

questions.prompt: Which mean the same as 「{弟弟|dìdi}{把|bǎ}{蛋糕|dàngāo}{吃|chī}{完|wán}{了|le}。」? Select all.
questions.explanation: 把 ⇄ 被: swap the two nouns, keep verb + result.

questions.prompt: Which is the correct 被 version of 「{风|fēng}{把|bǎ}{门|mén}{吹|chuī}{开|kāi}{了|le}。」?
notes: Now the door is blowing the wind.
The doer goes right after 被, before the verb.
questions.translation: The door was blown open by the wind.

questions.prompt: Build it: 'Don't let the cat eat the fish!'
questions.explanation: 别让猫**把鱼**吃了！ 把 + the fish (receiver) + 吃了.
questions.translation: Don't let the cat eat the fish!
